title: Oxva Slim Stick Lychee Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Lychee Ice Prefilled Pods are designed for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a distinctive fruit flavour with a cool edge. Each pod is filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs and a smooth throat hit. The flavour combines the naturally sweet, slightly floral taste of ripe Lychee with an icy lift, creating a vape that’s both exotic and refreshing. Built-in coils ensure consistent vapour and flavour performance throughout, while the closed pod design makes replacements quick, clean, and easy. Supplied in a pack of two, these pods are perfect for Slim Stick users seeking a smooth mouth-to-lung draw paired with a unique fruit-and-ice blend.
